Subject: Modernize order form: scope adjustment + change control for capacity add

Hi James / ClearSight legal team —

Per our call this morning, ClearSight is asking for an expedited capacity add (approx +20% throughput) and a temporary price hold for the first 6 months of the add. To keep momentum we want to propose a short change order that:

- Defines the new capacity SKU and activation date window (target: within 30 days of signed CO)
- Specifies billing proration language for partial-month activation
- Adds acceptance criteria and a 15-day ramp/verification window
- Holds the requested 6-month price floor and describes reversion terms thereafter

I attached our suggested redlines to the MSA plus the capacity worksheet with expected token volumes. Can you review and flag anything you won’t accept or that needs legal-level language? We also need an explicit list of required SLAs for the add so engineering can scope the rollout.

Attachments: [Attachment: ClearSight_MSA_redlines_20251110.pdf (PDF, 220 KB)], [Attachment: OrderForm_Capacity_Proposal.xlsx (XLSX, 85 KB)]

Requested next step: if legal can send back a short list of objections by EOD Tue 11/11 we’ll produce a formal change order draft for signature.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman

From: ClearSight Legal <legal@clearsight.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, James Singh <james.singh@clearsight.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Modernize order form: scope adjustment + change control for capacity add

Naomi —

Thanks for the redlines and the worksheet. We reviewed at a high level and have the following items that need clarification before we can approve the CO language:

1) Implementation window — your note says "within 30 days of signed CO". We need a firm latest-possible activation date and remedies if deployment exceeds that date.
2) Billing proration — clarify whether proration is pro rata to the day or month and whether usage before activation is billable.
3) Price hold — define the exact mechanism for reverting to standard rates after six months (automatic or requires notice).
4) SLA obligations — define measurable SLA targets for the added capacity or confirm they inherit the existing SLA.
5) Audit rights and data residency — ClearSight legal asks for a short carve for audit access around usage metrics for the new SKUs (one-time audit only).

We’ve attached our annotated comments in-line. Please ask your commercial and engineering teams to weigh in on items 1 and 2; once we have specifics we can route for signature.

Attachment: [Attachment: ClearSight_MSA_comments.docx (DOCX, 48 KB)]

Regards,
ClearSight Legal Team
legal@clearsight.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 11 Nov 2025 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Modernize order form: scope adjustment + change control for capacity add

Folks — forwarding ClearSight legal comments. Short timeline: they want clarified activation date, proration mechanics, and explicit SLA language. Can you both draft proposed contract language we can send back (and a recommended commercial approach) by EOD tomorrow? I drafted a few bullets below as a starting point:

- Activation window: "Customer may request activation within 30 days of signing; Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to activate within 15 business days of request; latest activation date shall be 45 days from signing, with defined credit remedies for delay beyond 45 days."
- Proration: "Charges for added capacity will be prorated to the day based on the activation date; no retroactive billing prior to activation."
- Price hold: "The adjusted price will remain fixed for 6 months from the effective date of the Change Order; thereafter the standard rate card applies unless mutually agreed otherwise in writing."
- SLA: "New capacity will inherit base SLA with an acceptance test (pass/fail) during a 15-day verification window; failed acceptance triggers remediation timeline in SOW."

Also, capture implementation prerequisites (SRE runbook, test endpoints) for Connor. I’m copying Laura so Legal Ops knows for signature routing.

Thanks — Naomi

--- Forwarded message attached from ClearSight Legal ---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Modernize order form: scope adjustment + change control for capacity add

Naomi —

Thanks for the forward. Proposed commercial language and options below (draft to be included in the change order):

1) Billing/proration (recommended): "Charges for the capacity add shall be prorated at a per-day granularity based on the effective activation date. Customer will not be charged for capacity prior to the documented activation date. If activation is delayed by more than 45 days from the Change Order Effective Date for reasons attributable to Redwood, Customer will receive a one-time service credit equal to 10% of the first-month invoice for the added capacity."

2) Price hold: "The unit price for the added capacity SKUs will be fixed for 6 months from the Change Order Effective Date. After 6 months, the standard rate card applies unless both parties sign an amendment."

3) Activation / remedies: "Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to activate within 15 business days following Customer's activation request. Latest activation date: 45 calendar days from Change Order Effective Date. If activation misses the 45-day latest activation date and Customer provides written notice, Redwood will provide the 10% one-time credit and publish a remediation plan within 5 business days."

4) Surge pool (optional add-on): recommend offering a limited 10% burst pool for first 30 days at the same held price to ease ramp risk; if accepted, include an exhibit.

I attached a draft change order that merges our redlines with ClearSight’s comments; please review and confirm we can send this to legal.

Attachment: [Attachment: CF_Addendum_Draft_20251112.docx (DOCX, 64 KB)]

-Karthik
Sales Director, Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 13 Nov 2025 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Modernize order form: scope adjustment + change control for capacity add

Naomi / Karthik —

Operational notes on rollout and acceptance tests:

- Implementation lead time: 10-15 business days typical if no infra changes required; allow 30-45 days if network peering or new VPC subnets are requested.
- Acceptance: provide endpoints and a 15-day verification window. Acceptance = passing 3 synthetic throughput scenarios and stable KV cache hit-rate > 85% for 48 hours.
- SRE tasks: add temporary routing rule, enable prefix caching for added SKUs, and schedule a 2-hr maintenance window for cutover.
- On auditing: we can provide the usage metrics reports Redwood-side but need ClearSight to sign the audit NDA for any access to raw logs.

If legal accepts the acceptance criteria above I’ll assemble the runbook and a 1-page ops checklist to include in the SOW exhibit.

-Connor
Principal Technical Program Manager, Redwood Inference

James / Legal team —

Thanks for the rapid review and the comments. Attached is a consolidated change order that incorporates your points and our proposed language on activation, proration, SLA/acceptance, and the 6-month price hold. Highlights included inline and summarized below:

- Activation: Latest activation date 45 days from Change Order Effective Date; remediation credit (10%) if missed for Redwood-attributable delays.
- Proration: pro-rated to the day based on activation date; no charges prior to activation.
- Price hold: fixed for 6 months from CO effective date, then standard rate card applies unless amended.
- Acceptance / SLA: 15-day verification window with the acceptance tests Connor outlined; failure triggers remediation timeline in Exhibit A.
- Audit access: limited one-time audit for usage metrics; must be scheduled and performed under mutually agreed NDA.

Attachments: [Attachment: Redwood_Clearsight_ChangeOrder_20251114.pdf (PDF, 98 KB)]
